scope: One finished hall, exterior arrival and roof outlook. Cellar deferred.

desktop.walk: WASD and mouse, arrow keys supported
desktop.fly: Optional controlled orbit around island with return to walking

mobile.walk: Left thumb joystick, right drag to look
mobile.alternatives: Tap named viewpoint for guided transition
mobile.fly: Drag to orbit, pinch to change distance

collision: Grounded capsule, wall and parapet collision, continuous stair ramps. To be tested in runtime.
readiness: Scene, textures, lighting and collision loaded before walking is enabled
artDirection: Realistic stone, water and landscape. Single post-rain lighting setup.
unverified: Historical placement and dimensions of individual openings
review: Layout approval required before final composition, Form approval before runtime export under build-3d-game-rooms skill.
